title: Pullbacks of Groupoid $C^*$-Algebras over Disjoint Invariant Sets
summary: We establish a pullback theorem for \(C^*\)-algebras of locally compact Hausdorff étale groupoids. The theorem shows that, when the unit space is covered by two closed invariant subsets whose complements are disjoint open invariant subsets, the corresponding groupoid \(C^*\)-algebras form a pullback diagram in the category of \(\mathbb T\)-\(C^*\)-algebras and \(\mathbb T\)-equivariant \(*\)-homomorphisms, for the gauge actions induced by a \(\mathbb Z\)-valued cocycle and its restrictions.
